name: resume-upload-timeout-resilience
title: Resume Upload Timeout Resilience
description: Fix resume upload timeout caused by inline PDF/DOCX parsing plus model-backed extraction exceeding the frontend 15s axios timeout.
creator: coldnight
notes: Accepted on 2026-08-01. Upload now saves the resume and raw text before scheduling model-backed fact extraction in the background. Frontend normalizes upload timeout errors and polls extraction status. Quality gates passed: backend ruff check/format, backend pytest, frontend lint/type-check/build, task validate, git diff --check.
